notes.subject: sheminit
notes.rationale: השמינית ye fɔlɔ-dɔn tɛmɛsira ye min kɔrɔ taamasiyɛn tɛ ɲɛfɔ; a bɛ se ka kɛ jɛgɛnsira wolonwulenan walima dɔnkili-minɛn-cogo ye

notes.subject: השמינית
notes.rationale: daɲɛ in Tanaki kɔnɔ a bɛ tuubu yɔrɔ caman na dɔrɔn (Zaburu 6:1, 12:1; 1 Tabu 15:21), a kɔrɔ ka datugulen

notes.subject: על
notes.gloss: Hebrew preposition rendered with locative 'na' since Bambara lacks a clean equivalent

translation: Minɛnɛbaga ma, sheminit-kɔnɔ na (dɔnkili min bɛ taa ni jɛgɛnsira wolonwulenan ye), Dawud (Dawuda) ka mizimor.
